items.title: This 2-Minute Trick Manifests $10K Effortlessly
items.text:
💎 Female founders: apply for your FREE Revenue Diagnostic
https://www.revenueforwomen.com

✨ FREE Money Activation community
https://www.skool.com/money-activatio...

I'm Giselle Baumet. I'm not a coach. I'm a behavioral scientist and doctoral researcher. I study how the brain handles money in women founders. Then I use that science to make manifestation work. I tested it on my own business first. Then I ran it with about 300 founders. My clients have grown revenue 2 to 6 times in under 6 months.

🧠 WHY YOUR MANIFESTATION ISN'T MOVING THE MONEY

You were right. Something invisible runs your income. It isn't your vibration. It's your prediction.

Your brain doesn't move you toward what you want. It moves you toward what it thinks you can survive. Before you raise your price or send the message, it runs a threat check. If it reads danger, it keeps you busy somewhere safer.

That's why you can want it this badly and still watch the money stay the same.

Your manifestation is already working. It's producing your current income with perfect accuracy.

🔄 WHAT I STUDY

You're posting, planning, doing everything. The money still isn't moving. So you think you need a better strategy, more discipline, or more desire.

It's none of those.

Something happens before you're even aware of it. A threat response that keeps the money from moving. I call it Execution Friction. And it can be measured.

Most money manifestation aims at desire. Desire was never the input.

💎 Find your pattern. Apply for your free Revenue Diagnostic:
https://www.revenueforwomen.com

🎙️Speaking Engagements: https://www.gisellebaumet.com
